security.invite_token_is_raw_bearer: PASS - bearerOf(c) strips 'Bearer ' from the Authorization header; never from body or hubAuth; test 'invites with the raw bearer...' pins it
security.no_organizationId_sent: PASS - client.create/resend/revoke/list carry no organizationId; a smuggled body organizationId is ignored and asserted absent (tests L250, L536)
security.requireAdmin_inherited: PASS - sellersAdminRouter mounted at adminRouter.route('/sellers') after adminRouter.use('*', appAuthMiddleware) and use('*', requireAdmin); /:id/resend and /:id/revoke inherit it
security.acceptUrl_and_bearer_never_logged: PASS - only error.name / HubInvitationError.code are logged; test spies every console method for the accept URL; acceptUrl is returned only in the admin's response body by design
security.no_raw_ids_in_ui: PASS - SalesOps account menu, MissingEntitlementPanel and NoRolePage render only name/email/avatar; the account block disappears when neither exists; active.id is only passed as the switchAccount hint

findings: NON-BLOCKING: no test drives the admin gate on /api/v1/admin/sellers (including the new /:id/resend and /:id/revoke) with a non-admin token; protection is structural only (adminRouter.use('*', requireAdmin)). Pre-existing gap, worth an oracle.
NON-BLOCKING: AccountAvatar is duplicated verbatim in SalesOpsApp.tsx and MissingEntitlementPanel.tsx (documented as a cycle-avoidance twin); a shared module would remove drift risk.
NON-BLOCKING: NoRolePage 'Trocar conta' has no double-click guard, unlike MissingEntitlementPanel's leavingAccount flag.
NON-BLOCKING: listSellers reconciles with N sequential UPDATEs and 4 Hub list calls on every GET when any seller has an invitation; fine at current scale.
